checks.text: Saeed reads the pattern and the examples (the Admin's real next numbers)
Saeed sets a Participant Code (2 to 6 letters or digits)
A code of one character is refused
A pattern that leaves out the Participant Code is refused until the shared-counter warning is accepted
With the warning accepted it saves (on UATP only)
The default pattern is saved back (counted by the Participant Code)
On the Tower, TMC's code (in use by numbered items) cannot be changed

notes: 'A code in use cannot change' needs a numbered item on UATP (raising items there needs Workflow setup); on the Tower the seeded TMC code is locked (codeLocked) and is not touched.
